card.name: Words before 'secondary' or minor role
card.fires_on: A word just before a phrase saying something is secondary, minor or less important, such as 'a back seat', 'less of a role' or 'minor pathways'. It also fires on the start of 'subordinated'.

modes.label: Relegated to lower rank
modes.description: Verb or article leading into a phrase that puts something in a lesser position.
modes.example: Chinese counterintelligence was relegated to<< a>> back seat.

modes.label: Minor metabolic pathways
modes.description: Linking word before a drug pathway described as minor or secondary.
modes.example: Doxepin is primarily metabolized by CYP2D6 (with CYP1A2 & CYP3A4<< as>> minor pathways).

modes.label: Subordinate role
modes.description: Word that starts or leads into a statement that something plays a lesser part.
modes.example: His social policy was always<< sub>>ordinated to his racial policy.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying 'secondary' or 'tertiary' next.
